---
title: "melb_walk_wide"
output: html_document
---

## Load tidyverse
```{R}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read melb_walk.csv 
```{R}
ped_wide <- read_csv("data/melb_walk_wide.csv")
```

## Print ped_wide
```{R}
ped_wide
```

## First and last date in the data
```{R}
ped_wide %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    first_date = first(Date),
    last_date = last(Date)
  )
```

## Convert to long form
```{R}
ped <- ped_wide %>%
  gather(key = Sensor, value = Count, -Date_Time, -Date, -Time ) %>%
  select(Sensor, everything(), Count)

ped
```

##  State Library on the 1st of January, 2019.
```{R}
# Filter for State Library data on Jan 1, 2019 
state_lib_jan_one <- ped %>%
  filter(Date == "2019-01-01", Sensor == "State Library")

state_lib_jan_one
```

## Values from state_lib_jan_one
```{R}
# number of columns 
no_col <- ncol(state_lib_jan_one)
no_col

# number of row 
no_row <- nrow(state_lib_jan_one)
no_row 

# hour with highest pedestrian count
hour_highest_ped_count <- state_lib_jan_one %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  slice(1) %>% 
  select(everything())
hour_highest_ped_count
```

## Line plot of State Library pedestrian count
```{R}
state_lin_jan_one_line_plot <- state_lib_jan_one %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count)) + geom_line()

state_lin_jan_one_line_plot
```

## Bar plot of count
```{R}
state_lib_jan_one_bar_plot <- state_lib_jan_one %>% ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity")

state_lib_jan_one_bar_plot
```

## Side-by-side box plot
```{R}
# Filter for State Library
state_lib <- ped %>%
  filter(Sensor == "State Library")

state_lib

# Side-by-side box plot of pedestrian count for each hour of the day 
state_lib_side_by_side_box <- state_lib %>% ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, group = Time)) + geom_boxplot()

state_lib_side_by_side_box

# Without time (one big box plot)
state_lib_box_plot <- state_lib %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count)) + geom_boxplot()

state_lib_box_plot
```

## Filter for multiple sensors
```{R}
# Filter for the Melbourne Central and State Library sensors
mc_sl <- ped %>%
  filter(Sensor %in% c("Melbourne Central", "State Library"))

mc_sl

# Filter everything except mc_cl 
except_mc_sl <- ped %>%
  filter(!Sensor %in% c("Melbourne Central", "State Library"))

except_mc_sl
```

## Facetted side-by-side box plots
```{R}
# Side-by-side box plot of pedestrian count for each hour of the day facetted by Sensor 
facetted_side_by_side_box_plot <- mc_sl %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, group = Time)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~ Sensor)

facetted_side_by_side_box_plot
```

## Facetted side-by-side box plots removed outliers
```{R}
# Remove outliers and produce facetted plot with 1 column
# facet_wrap() split single plot into multiple side-by-side panels - one for each unique value in Sensor
facetted_except_outlier <- mc_sl %>% 
  filter(Count < 5000) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, group = Time)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~ Sensor, ncol = 1)

facetted_except_outlier
```

## Grouping
```{R}
# Number of sensors in the ped 
num_sensor <- ped %>% summarise(num_sensors = n_distinct(Sensor))

num_sensor

# For each sensor, compute the total count for January. Which sensor had the largest count? Which sensor had the smallest count?
total_counts <- ped %>% group_by(Sensor) %>% summarise(sum = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup %>% arrange(desc(sum))

total_counts

largest_count <- total_counts %>% slice_head()
largest_count 

smallest_count <- total_counts %>% slice_tail()
smallest_count

# For each sensor, compute the total number of missing counts. Which sensor had the most missing counts? Why might this be?
total_missing <- ped %>% group_by(Sensor) %>% summarise(tot_missing = sum(is.na(Count))) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(desc(tot_missing))

total_missing

largest_tot <- total_missing %>% slice_head()
largest_tot 

smallest_tot <- total_missing %>% slice_tail()
smallest_tot
  

# Filter ped to contain the counts from the Melbourne Central and State Library sensors only, then use a tidying function to create two columns that contain their counts.
mc_sl_count <- ped %>% filter(Sensor %in% c("Melbourne Central", "State Library")) %>% spread(key = Sensor, value = Count) %>% select("Melbourne Central", "State Library", everything())

mc_sl_count
```

## 100 per cent chart
```{R}
# Create the following 100 per cent chart to compare the foot traffic at Melbourne Central and the State Library during different hours of the day
ped_100_percent <- ped %>% 
  filter(Sensor %in% c("Melbourne Central", "State Library")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, fill = Sensor)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
  facet_wrap(~ Date, ncol = 7) + 
  labs(title = "Comparing foot traffic at Melbourne Central and the State Library during different hours of the day", subtitle = "Greater proportion of foot traffic at the State Library than Melbourne Central during the afternoon")

ped_100_percent
```
